        torch.randn(BATCH_SIZE, SEQ_LEN, HIDDEN_SIZE bfloat16 ),

        torch.randn(HIDDEN_SIZE, INTERMEDIATE_SIZE bfloat16 ) / math.sqrt(INTERMEDIATE_SIZE),
